plan.title: Young Minds: Science, Reading and Creativity Day

tasks.label: Approve programme, invitation, venue and expenditure
Organise science demonstrations and check materials
Coordinate seating, printed materials, refreshments and supplier quotations
Select pupil presentations, supervise rehearsals and prepare project labels

drafts.invitation:
Young Minds: Science, Reading and Creativity Day
Confirmed Date: Saturday, 14 November 2026
Proposed Venue: School’s Main Assembly Hall [Pending Confirmation]

Dear Parents and Guardians,

We warmly invite you to attend our upcoming "Young Minds: Science, Reading and Creativity Day." This special event is designed to celebrate our pupils' achievements and provide a platform for them to demonstrate their classroom learning through engaging science projects, storytelling, reading presentations, and creative displays.

Our goal is to share the wonderful progress your children have made and to encourage practical, hands-on learning within the home environment. During the programme, you can expect to see live science demonstrations, enjoy reading presentations by the pupils, and participate in a shared reading activity. 

Attendance is free of charge. Please note that the exact starting time and the final venue (Main Assembly Hall or School Library) are currently awaiting final approval and will be confirmed with you shortly.

We look forward to celebrating our pupils' creativity and curiosity with you.

Warm regards,

Mrs Grace Okoro
Headteacher
On behalf of Sunrise Learning Centre

Safety and Supervision:
- Science activities must use simple, low-risk classroom materials. Avoid flames, exposed electrical connections, sharp tools, or experiments involving hazardous chemicals.
- Teachers must supervise all demonstrations, display areas, and pupil movement.
- Parents should remain with younger children during the guided display tour.
- The designated first-aid officer must be available throughout the programme.
